title: Construction with Quadrotor Teams
summary: A short GRASP Lab (University of Pennsylvania) demo in which teams of quadrotors autonomously assemble tower-like cubic structures from modular parts. The drones are given the target structure and work out the assembly plan themselves.
why: HN uses it as a go-to example of drones and robotics doing construction work.

quote.text: We tell the quadrotors what structure﻿ to build and they figure out the assembly plan and then build it.
